description: Use when the user asks about their e-mail: what came in, finding a message, summarizing a thread, or drafting a reply

taskTemplates.prompt: Use the mail-assistant skill. Summarize the e-mail received in the last 24 hours (use mail.list and check the dates): group it by what needs a reply, what needs action, and what is only for information. Mention the sender and subject of each item. Do not draft or send anything.
